Name: GMCM Mod Name I18n Text Addition
Author: passersby10086
Description:
[size=4]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)是一个很实用的mod，但是有一个小小的问题。需要修改config的mod在GMCM的界面会以英文状态展现名字。除非你去修改manifest.json文件。但是，这一工作每次模组更新都需要进行一次，这并不方便。

模组作者 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/151142238]435201823[/url] 为此制作了[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45825]GMCMModNameI18n[/url]，具体详细的功能请观看对应mod网页。GMCMModNameI18n可以让GMCM读取它的i18n文件以实现稳定的翻译。而它的i18n需要译者自行添加对应的mod。

我尝试将一部分常用的mod的名称添加进入了i18n，这项工作比较费时，我目前只完成了其中一小部分。而且，我是根据本人自己的mod包进行的修改，不能保证满足所有人的需要。因此，如果有哪个mod没有包含在内，可以留言。如果我完成了对我所使用的mod的整合后仍然有时间，我会适当添加其他我没有使用的mod。

The Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) is a very useful mod, but there is a minor issue with it. Mods that need to modify the config will have their names displayed in English on the GMCM interface. Unless you go and modify the manifest.json file. However, this process needs to be carried out every time a module is updated, which is not very convenient. 

The mod author [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/151142238]435201823[/url] has created [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45825]GMCMModNameI18n[/url] for this purpose. For detailed information about the functions, please visit the corresponding mod webpage.GMCMModNameI18n enables GMCM to read its i18n file to achieve stable translation. And for its i18n, the translator needs to add the corresponding modifications themselves.

I attempted to incorporate the names of some commonly used mods into the i18n system. This task was quite time-consuming and I have only completed a small portion of it so far. Moreover, the modifications I made were based on my own mod package, and I cannot guarantee that they will meet the needs of everyone. Therefore, if any mod is not included, please leave a message. If I have time after completing the integration of the mods I'm using, I will appropriately add other mods that I haven't used yet.[/size]
